issues.description: Function 'sum(a, b)': The problem statement requires implementing sum(a, b) to add two integers passed on the stack. The solution repository defines a 'sum' label that only reads the first argument into eax (mov eax, [esp+4]) and immediately returns without using or adding the second argument. This contradicts the specification and will confuse students about the expected stack offsets and the correct implementation of sum(a, b).
issues.suggestedFix:
Update the solution's sum implementation to actually add both stack arguments using the expected calling convention/stack layout. For example (cdecl-like):
    mov eax, [esp+4]    ; load a
    add eax, [esp+8]    ; add b
    ret
Also update any accompanying explanation/comments to document the stack offsets and calling convention so students can implement sum(a, b) as specified.
